messages:
Marta (Design): Quick usability spot from the QA pass: on 1366px the Export controls get compressed into the more menu and the export modal info is hard to find. Screenshot attached. Can we make the primary export more discoverable and safe?
Dev (Frontend): Repro. The toolbar wraps at medium widths. Short-term: promote the Export button to a solid primary and pin it to the right. Long-term: move format + vector inclusion into a clear export modal.
Asha (Product): Product asks: prevent accidental giant downloads. Suggest: preflight estimate of compressed size and an explicit confirmation if >75MB. Also allow NDJSON by default for very large exports.
Ken (ML): Technical feasibility: server can sample rows, gzip a handful and extrapolate. We can return an estimated gzipped bytes value and a recommended format: CSV or NDJSON. For exports we should support: CSV, NDJSON, and a server-generated ZIP that bundles a _meta.json.
Marta (Design): Copy ideas: toolbar label 'Export dataset' (primary). In modal header: 'Export dataset' with subtext 'Choose format and whether to include raw vectors (raw vectors can be large)'. Checkbox: 'Include vectors (raw)'. Warning line example: 'Estimated size: ~120MB gzipped. Recommended: NDJSON.'
Dev (Frontend): I'll replace textarea serialization with Blob streaming and add a call to /api/estimate-export. If estimate > threshold, show modal with pre-check to confirm. For client-side downloads we use stream -> Blob -> anchor. Fallback to server zip for very large payloads.
Liv (A11y): Accessibility checklist: 1) Export modal must be role="dialog" with aria-labelledby and focus trap. 2) Announce recommendations (aria-live="polite") when estimate changes. 3) Make pinned Export and Pin Actions keyboard focusable. 4) Provide text alternatives for visual rank deltas, e.g., "+0.12 (rank +3)".
Asha (Product): UX decision: default CSV when estimate <= 50MB, recommend NDJSON when >50MB and require explicit confirmation when >75MB. Soft cap full-vector CSV to 20k rows for self-serve; enterprise can request overrides via support link in modal. Also include a small 'Why NDJSON?' help link.
Ken (ML): For NDJSON we should include an optional _meta.json with keys: dataset_id, row_count, vector_dim, export_time. Server will stream a zip (manifest + file) to avoid client memory pressure. We'll also emit metrics: rows_streamed, bytes_sent, compressed_bytes for support.
Marta (Design): UI follow-ups: 1) Add 'Condense rows' toggle in toolbar (text + shortcut Ctrl+Shift+C). 2) Collapse preview into per-row expanders so the table stays column-aligned. 3) Add a 'Pin actions' toggle so Export doesn't get hidden by overlays.
Liv (A11y): Keyboard shortcut note: expose shortcuts in the help overlay and ensure reduced-motion respected for expand animations. For aria-live messages keep them polite.
Dev (Frontend): I'll open a single PR with: toolbar layout changes, /api/estimate-export, Blob streaming for client download, and modal flows. Tests will include a regression case for previously truncated exports.
Asha (Product): Add an analytics event for large export confirmations and a support contact link for enterprise export increases. Also show an estimated compressed size badge near format selector.
export-bot: Created ticket UI-6120: "Export discoverability + safe large-export flow (estimate, NDJSON, manifest, a11y)" and linked mocks + PR placeholders.
